title: Penalty Kick
description: Step up to the spot and beat the goalkeeper! Aim your shot, time the power bar and curl the ball into the corner. Then dive to save the keeper's shots.
instructions: Shooting: click or tap where you want to aim, then stop the power bar.
Keyboard: arrow keys aim, Space shoots.
Saving: click, tap or press an arrow key to dive.
Win the shoot-out over five rounds.
